about: The widget agent's tool scope for each kind of target (design/widget-agent.md, The tool scope). The app's context bundle (src/builder/session/context_bundle.cpp, which embeds this file at build time) and the caliper-agent sidecar (caliper_agent/widget.py, which reads it at start) derive the scope from it and from the command table with one rule: a listed command that the table does not have is passed by; a read must not mutate; an edit must mutate, take a boolean dry_run in its arguments schema and not be destructive; nothing in never or never_groups qualifies; the vision_only commands leave the scope when the model reads no images; the scope keeps the table's order.
